content: {"episode_id":"ep-05192","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states is not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (G45.9, Z86.73) who is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms. On this documented indication, CPT 93229 is medically necessary and we request review and reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 436.44."}
